newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Mayor gunned down in northwest Colombia.
newsitem.headline: Mayor gunned down in northwest Colombia.

text.p: Unidentified gunmen shot and killed a ruling Liberal Party mayor in rural Colombia on Tuesday in the fourth such incident so far this year, authorities said.

Police spokesmen said 35-year-old Hector Bedoya was killed by several pistol-wielding gunmen shortly after presiding over a meeting of local peasants in the small town of Heliconia, 160 miles (260 km) northwest of Bogota in violence-torn Antioquia province.
Gunmen of the left and right have killed four small town mayors in Colombia so far this year and 14 were assassinated across the country in 1996.
